why: A mutation score is only interpretable beside the operator set that produced it,
the same way the deposit's rates are only interpretable beside their measurement
regime. Someone measuring with mutmut or cosmic-ray will get a different number;
this file is what the difference is anchored to.

operators.cmp: comparison operator swap: == <-> !=, < <-> >=, <= <-> >, in <-> not in, is <-> is not
operators.const_int: integer constant perturbation (+1) for values in {0, 1, 16}

protocol: single-point mutants, one at a time, applied to the source on disk;
a mutant is killed if the target's OWN test files fail (fast pass);
every survivor of the fast pass is re-run against the FULL suite;
a hang counts as killed; the original source is restored after every mutant
caveats: The score is bounded by this operator set: statement deletion, exception-type
swaps and string mutations are not attempted, so the true survivor count under a
richer operator set is >= the one reported here.
Equivalence of a surviving mutant is undecidable in general; survivors are judged
equivalent ON REVIEW, and that judgement is recorded, not asserted as fact.
